mandate.objective: Fix issue #417 and leave a mergeable pull request if objective CI gates pass.
invariants: Do not weaken tests or repository protections to obtain a passing result.
Public API compatibility must be preserved unless escalated.
Changes must remain reversible through version control.

completion: A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it.
Required CI checks pass on the exact head commit.
The pull request contains only changes causally required by the mandate.
checkpoints: Escalate if the reproduced failure contradicts issue #417's premise.
Escalate if a public API break appears necessary.

triggers: Evidence cannot distinguish mandate failure from infrastructure failure.
Objective CI gates conflict with one another.

stop_when: The PR is merged after objective repository gates pass.
The owner revokes or supersedes the mandate.
Escalation is required and no delegated authority remains.
